versions.changelog:
StoryShort 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create, render, and publish AI videos, images, and clips via StoryShort MCP server.
- Full option discovery (voices, caption themes, styles, models, and exact credit pricing) before creating content.
- Estimate and clearly quote credit costs before spending.
- Direct publishing to TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram supported.
- Asynchronous workflow with video and media polling, plus error relaying.
- Standalone image and AI video generation included.
